name: Healer
summary: Spend a Healer's Kit use so a creature can roll a Hit Point Die plus your Proficiency Bonus; reroll healing 1s.

benefits.name: Battle Medic
benefits.summary: Utilize action: expend a Healer's Kit use; a creature within 5 ft spends a Hit Point Die and heals roll + PB.
benefits.text: If you carry a Healer's Kit, you can take a Utilize action to expend one of its uses and tend a creature within 5 feet of you. That creature can expend one of its Hit Point Dice; you roll that die, and the creature regains Hit Points equal to the result plus your Proficiency Bonus.

benefits.name: Healing Rerolls
benefits.summary: Reroll any 1 on a die that sets the Hit Points you restore with a spell or Battle Medic.
benefits.text: Whenever you roll a die to determine how many Hit Points you restore with a spell or with this feat's Battle Medic benefit, you can reroll the die if it shows a 1, and you must keep the new result.
